shortDescription: Bihar School Examination Board has released the Library Eligibility Test BLET 2026 short notice. Online applications are scheduled from 01 October 2026 to 21 October 2026.
content:
Bihar School Examination Board (BSEB) has released the Bihar Library Eligibility Test (BLET) 2026 notification update.

Candidates interested in the BLET examination can apply online from 01 October 2026 to 21 October 2026. The application link is expected to be activated on 01 October 2026. Read the official notification carefully for eligibility, age limit, fee, syllabus and the selection procedure before applying.

Important dates

  • Application begins: 01 October 2026
  • Last date to apply and pay fee: 21 October 2026
  • Correction last date: As per official schedule
  • BLET exam date: As per schedule
  • Admit card: Before the examination
  • Result: To be notified soon

Eligibility and documents

Detailed eligibility will be updated by BSEB. Candidates should keep their Class 10, Class 12, graduation, post-graduation and B.Ed documents ready, along with photograph, signature, category certificate and domicile certificate wherever applicable.

How to apply

  1. Open the official BSEB website after the form link is activated.
  2. Complete registration and enter the required details.
  3. Upload scanned documents and pay the online fee after it is announced.
  4. Check the preview carefully and submit the application.
  5. Print the final submitted form for future reference.

The short notice is available through the official BSEB social media update. Use the official BSEB website for the latest application link and notification.
statusNote: Online application link will be activated on 01/10/2026.
